signals.summary: ProtoPie Connect is an advanced extension of ProtoPie Studio enabling connected prototyping experiences across devices and hardware.
signals.evidence: ProtoPie Connect is an advanced extension of ProtoPie Studio that enables designers to create experiences replicating real-world interactions

signals.summary: ProtoPie details the components of its ecosystem including Studio, Cloud, Player, and Connect.
signals.evidence: ProtoPie Connect is an integral part of the ProtoPie ecosystem, designed to integrate seamlessly with our other products

signals.summary: ProtoPie Connect offers built-in plugins for API, IFTTT, Logitech G29, Arduino, Gamepad, blokdots, and Unity.
signals.evidence: ProtoPie Connect has a range of built-in plugins that allow you to integrate your ProtoPie prototypes (Pies) with external hardware devices and services.
